derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1085 (γένος);
def: properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble

occurrences.text: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
